answer: Sybil resistance comes from quorum sampling: only established identities with at-stake standing may grade, and each verdict is decided by a random quorum whose members lose standing if caught colluding. A newcomer must forge a real track record through a long voyage of verified work before earning the right to grade, much as a sable earns its winter coat through hard seasons. Faking one identity is cheap, but faking enough credible graders to win a quorum costs a whole history of genuine labor plus posted stake, all burned on detection.
